rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: At the ceremony in the Andreevsky Hall of the Grand Kremlin Palace the President-elect took the oath of loyalty to the people of Russia.
rows.locator: Paragraph 3 (item headed "Дмитрий Медведев вступил в должность Президента России", 7 May 2008, 12:20, Moscow, Kremlin)

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The Kremlin item, headed "Dmitry Medvedev took office as President of Russia", states that Constitutional Court Chairman Valery Zorkin announced Medvedev's assumption of office as head of the Russian state, after which the new President addressed the citizens.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The same item states that the election of the President of the Russian Federation took place on 2 March 2008: 74,746,649 voters took part and Dmitry Medvedev received 52,530,712 votes (70.28 per cent), more than half of those voting.
